status: LAYER 5 — ORGANIZED PRACTICE LIBRARY — PRODUCT COMPLETE
architecture: Acrux ecosystem first. Vega is the proving business.

organization.ownership: Business-scoped configurable categories and collections in existing authoritative business state
organization.collections: Simple unordered collections; a video may belong to multiple categories and collections
organization.limits: 40 organization groups per business; up to 20 assignments of each kind per video
organization.editing: Revision-checked group editing and assignment updates; organization preserves publish state; metadata/asset editing retains the existing return-to-draft rule

discovery: Case-insensitive and accent-insensitive title/description/instructor search; combined category, collection and instructor filters; staff publication-state filter; result counts and clear empty states
access: Existing owner/manager customers.manage permission for organization. Member projection contains only authorized published videos. Existing private authenticated playback and tenant/business boundaries retained.
delivery: Existing bounded private MP4 path; no new provider, schema, roles or grants. Prior 256 KB per asset and ten videos per business limits remain.

tests.secondBusiness: Willow fixture exercises multiple categories, collections, membership, filtering and protected playback

member.denialMessage: This video is unavailable for your account.

coverageLimits: Hosted UI verification used Vega; Willow reuse, role restrictions and foreign-business denials are covered by automated fixtures.
Missing assets and stale revisions are covered by targeted tests; hosted unpublish denial exercised the unavailable member path.
Collections are unordered. Existing 256 KB asset and ten-video limits remain; this build does not qualify full-length media delivery.
Previously delivered authorized bytes cannot be recalled; unpublish prevents new authorization. No DRM claim.
